description: Delete an async operation to delete the Azure AD B2C tenant and Azure resource. The resource deletion can only happen as the last step in [the tenant deletion process](https://aka.ms/deleteB2Ctenant).

operations.description: Initiates an async operation to delete the Azure AD B2C tenant and Azure resource. The resource deletion can only happen as the last step in [the tenant deletion process](https://aka.ms/deleteB2Ctenant).

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The initial domain name of the Azure AD B2C tenant.
params.name: resourceName

params.description: Subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: Version of the API to be used with the client request.
consts.name: api-version

responses.description: Response of the URL in Location header if the asynchronous operation is successful. Resource will no longer exist.
Resource deletion request accepted. The Location header indicates the URL/location in which to poll for a result of the asynchronous operation.
NoContent - Azure AD B2C tenant resource successfully deleted or didn't exist.
Error response describing why the operation failed.
